item.title: Nanoneedle arrays map RNA in fresh tissue without sequencing or amplification
item.description: Recently, spatial omics has become a powerful tool, enabling researchers to see not only what molecules are present in a tissue, but also where they are located and how they are organized across cells, tissue structures and local microenvironments.
